next_mission_recommendation.mission_title: Add project_name field to the Create Mission form with validation
next_mission_recommendation.mission_description: The queue item edit modal now supports project_name editing, but the initial Create Mission form (the 'Add to Queue' dialog) should also include a project_name field with the same autocomplete functionality. Additionally, add optional validation that warns users if they type a project name that doesn't exist in the workspace yet (but still allows it). This would provide a consistent experience where project_name can be set at creation time rather than only after queuing. Also consider adding a 'Create New Project' button that creates the workspace directory when a non-existent name is entered.
next_mission_recommendation.rationale: This is the natural complement to the edit modal change - if users can edit project_name after queuing, they should also be able to set it when first creating a mission. This completes the project_name workflow and reduces the need to edit missions post-creation.

final_report.summary: Successfully extended the queue item edit modal to support editing the project_name field for queued missions. Two files were modified: the backend queue_scheduler.py (added project_name to allowed update fields + new /api/queue/workspace-projects endpoint) and the frontend queue.js (added project_name input with HTML5 datalist autocomplete, fetch logic for workspace projects, and inclusion in save payload). The implementation uses native HTML5 datalist for autocomplete, showing all 171 existing workspace directories while still allowing custom names. All 13 functional and adversarial tests passed, including XSS injection, path traversal, and edge case inputs.
key_achievements: Added project_name editing to queue item edit modal with pre-populated current value
Built /api/queue/workspace-projects API endpoint returning sorted workspace directories
Implemented HTML5 datalist autocomplete showing 171 existing projects
Users can type custom project names or select from existing workspace projects
Empty/blank input properly clears project_name (sends null)
Fixed modal display issue (added modal.style.display = 'flex') across three modal functions
All changes are XSS-safe via existing escapeHtml() function
challenges_overcome: Modal display bug - modals were being appended to DOM but not shown; fixed by setting display:flex
Ensuring project_name field works bidirectionally (set, change, clear, set again) through the update API
lessons_learned: HTML5 datalist provides native autocomplete without any external dependencies - ideal for simple dropdown/autocomplete needs
Adding a field to an existing edit modal requires changes in 3 places: backend allowed_fields whitelist, frontend form HTML, and frontend save payload
Testing CRUD operations on a new field should cover the full lifecycle: create, update, clear, re-create
Adversarial testing (XSS, long inputs, special chars) is quick to add and catches real issues
